name: Pipeliners - Indexing Phase 1 2026-09-12
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-12

# Summary
"Why 26 pages aren't in Google, and what to do", checked Sep 12, 2026 (review only). Written as a decision document for Kim with choices A to E.

# Key findings
- Search Console was still pointed at two dead sitemaps (page-sitemap.xml and post-sitemap.xml, 404 since mid-July). Google listed them as the source for the blog, the leak detection page and other never-visited pages.
- The live sitemap listed 8 noindexed URLs: 5 safe to remove now (footer template, cookie popup, 3 tag pages); 3 still in Google to keep until they show as excluded.
- Only 3 of 26 unindexed pages were ready to request: /repair-sewer-line-without-digging/, /blog/, /5-signs-you-need-to-repipe-your-home-in-arizona/. /slab-leaks-phoenix/ turned out to be indexed.
- The leak detection page was 77% copied from /trenchless-drain-pipe-repair/.
- Grouping of the 26: 3 ready, 1 already indexed, 8 improve first, 11 merge into a stronger page, 1 keep and add links, 1 needs input (/pipeline-locating/: does Pipeliners locate sewer lines with its camera?), 1 leave alone (/pipelining/, a Google Ads page).

# Decisions and status
- A: clean the sitemap (5 URLs out, 126 to 121) via a MetaSync excluded-URLs setting. B: remove the dead sitemaps in GSC and resubmit sitemap_index.xml. C: free Request Indexing for the 3 ready pages. D: approve the content plan as a to-do list.
- Per the change log and later notes, the sitemap and GSC cleanup ran Sep 14 to 15 and the merge plan went live Sep 19.
